title: 第十七章 逃命第十八章 新洲地铁站
slug: 盗三界第五百六十章黑影
lines: 几人正忙着，忽见对面街道里，走出来七八名同学。
“江雪瑶！”
“是杨小冰他们！”
同学们都是眼睛一亮，纷纷跑到几人面前。
“是枪！”
“见者有份！”
“分给我们一些！”
他们正说着，却被那名警察挡住了。
“你们几个是什么人？不要妨碍我执行任务，立刻散去！”
警察沉声喝道。
有人不服气地说：“他们都能得到枪支，凭什么——”
“他们帮我击杀了两头魔物，你们是什么身份？又做了什么？”警察不屑地说。
这时大家才反应过来。
是啊。
这可是考试！
如果什么都没做，就想获得武力加持，想一步登天，怎么可能！
老师们肯定都设置好了的！
再看那警察。
他的手已经按在了枪上。
如果再无理取闹，恐怕事情就不会这么简单了。
在妖魔屠城的事件中，不仅帮不上忙，还添乱的话……
恐怕连及格分都达不到。
“是我们不对。”
“不好意思。”
几名学生讪然道歉，后退几步，隐入黑暗之中，继续朝着别的方向去了。
许源装备已毕，笑着朝那警察道：
“我是许源，不知如何称呼您？”
“柳山行。”警察道。
“柳警官，我们还有什么可以帮上忙的？”许源问。
杨小冰、江雪瑶和赵阿飞都已准备走了，却听见他这样说，不由都是一愣。
许源冲他们摇摇头，表示稍安勿躁。
——都还是学生，自然不知道这个时候要刷一刷人物的“好感度”，顺便刺探情报。
走过路过不要错过。
老鸟们为了努力探索剧情，什么都做得出来。
具体结合到这一刻——
自己的行为，就像是在认真地为城市治安提供帮助，一点也不突兀。
就算从考试的角度来看，也完全说得通。
柳警官意外地说：
“你们不是还有事吗？”
“非常感谢您提供装备武器，我们的事也不算多重要，如果您这边需要支援，我们当仁不让。”许源说道。
柳警官脸上多了一缕笑意：
“你们实力非凡，确实也能帮上我的忙。”
“您说吧。”许源道。

A few people were busy when they suddenly saw seven or eight classmates walking out from the street opposite.
"Jiang Xueyao!"
"It's Yang Xiaobing and the others!"
The students' eyes lit up and they ran to several people.
"It's a gun!"
"Everyone who meets you has a share!"
"Give us some!"
As they were talking, they were blocked by the policeman.
"Who are you? Don't hinder me from carrying out my mission. Disperse immediately!"
The policeman shouted in a deep voice.
Someone said unconvinced: "They can all get guns, why -"
"They helped me kill two monsters. Who are you? What did you do?" the policeman said disdainfully.
Only then did everyone react.
yes.
This is an exam!
If you don't do anything and just want to get the blessing of force and reach the sky in one step, how is it possible?
The teachers must have set it up!
Look at the policeman again.
His hand was already on the gun.
If we continue to make trouble unreasonably, I'm afraid things won't be so simple.
In the event of the demon massacre, not only would it not be able to help, but it would also add to the chaos...
I'm afraid I won't even get a passing grade.
"It's our fault."
"Sorry."
Several students apologized profusely, took a few steps back, disappeared into the darkness, and continued in another direction.
Xu Yuan finished his equipment and smiled and said to the policeman:
"I am Xu Yuan, I don't know how to call you?"
"Liu Shan Xing." The policeman said.
"Officer Liu, is there anything else we can do to help?" Xu Yuan asked.
Yang Xiaobing, Jiang Xueyao and Zhao Afei were all ready to leave, but they were all stunned when they heard him say this.
Xu Yuan shook his head at them, saying that he should be patient.
——We are all still students, so naturally we don’t know that we need to brush up on the character’s “favorability” at this time and gather information by the way.
Don't miss it if you pass by.
The veterans will do anything in order to explore the plot.
Specifically combined to this moment——
His behavior is as if he is seriously providing help to the city's security, and it is not abrupt at all.
Even from an exam perspective, it makes perfect sense.
Officer Liu said unexpectedly:
"Don't you have something else to do?"
"Thank you very much for providing equipment and weapons. Our affairs are not that important. If you need support here, we will do our part." Xu Yuan said.
Officer Liu had a smile on his face:
"You have extraordinary strength, and you can indeed help me."
"You tell me." Xu Yuan said.
